name: gabriel_graph (Gabriel proximity graph of a spatial point set)

benchmarks.note: deterministic LCG scatter in the unit square. The kernel enumerates all O(n^2) candidate pairs and runs an O(n) empty-ball test per pair, so cost is cubic in the point count: 25->100 (4x points) is ~16x time, 100->200 (2x points) is ~4.7x time, both tracking the n^3 expectation

k x k integer lattice (k in 5,10,14): every cell's opposite corners are co-circular, so the closed-ball boundary branch fires on the diagonals. Slightly slower than the scatter at equal n because more pairs survive far enough into the empty-ball loop before rejection; still cubic overall
